title: Gameplay Controller Interface Schema Definition
description: Based on UGAS Specification v1.0.0-draft.4 - Section 4

OwnerActor.description: Logical owner of the GC (responsible for lifecycle, network authority, persistence)

ActorID.description: Unique identifier for the owner actor

AvatarActor.description: World spatial representation (optional, can be same as Owner)

ActorID.description: Unique identifier for the avatar actor

InputID.description: Input binding identifier. References an Action Name from the input layer. When the bound Action triggers, the GC calls TryActivateAbility for this grant.

Handle.description: Unique handle for this granted ability instance

bIsActive.description: Whether the ability is currently active

GrantedAbilities.description: All abilities granted to this GC

Handle.description: Unique identifier for this active effect

DurationPolicy.description: Duration policy of the originating effect (§14.3)

RemainingDuration.description: Remaining duration in seconds. Present only for HasDuration effects (§14.3.1)

InstigatorGC.description: Reference to the GC that caused this effect

SourceAbility.description: Ability that applied this effect (for provenance tracking, §14.3.2)

PeriodicState.description: Periodic execution state for effects with Period settings (§14.3.3)

PeriodElapsed.description: Seconds elapsed since last periodic execution

CapturedAttributes.description: Attribute values captured OnApplication, keyed by attribute name (§14.3)

SetByCallerMagnitudes.description: Runtime-provided magnitudes, keyed by data tag (§14.3)

ActiveEffects.description: Currently active effects applied to this GC (serialization protocol §14)

ActiveActionSets.description: Currently active ActionSet names (derived from tag evaluation at runtime)

OwnedTags.description: Current semantic state tags (hierarchical dot notation)

ReplicationMode.description: Replication strategy: Minimal (only cues & tags for AI), Mixed (full to owner, minimal to others for players), Full (complete to all for single-player/spectators), None (no replication for server-only)

bIsActive.description: Whether this GC is currently active

Metadata.description: Optional metadata for display and debugging
